"""RFC-7807-style validation problem documents for Meridian CRM."""

from __future__ import annotations

_LEGACY_CODES = (
    "E1001",
    "E1002",
    "E1003",
    "E1004",
    "E1005",
    "E2001",
    "E2002",
    "E2003",
    "E2004",
    "E3001",
    "E3002",
    "E3003",
    "E3004",
    "E3005",
    "E3006",
    "E3007",
    "E4001",
    "E4002",
    "E4003",
    "E4004",
    "E5001",
    "E5002",
    "E5003",
    "E5004",
    "E5005",
)

_LEGACY_CODE_SET = frozenset(_LEGACY_CODES)
_PROBLEM_TYPE = "https://meridian-crm.example/problems/validation"
_PROBLEM_TITLE = "Legacy validation failed"


def problem_details(errors: list[dict]) -> dict:
    """Build a validation problem document from collected rule failures."""
    for error in errors:
        code = error["code"]
        if code not in _LEGACY_CODE_SET:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown legacy validation code: {code}")

    migrated_errors = [
        {
            "code": error["code"],
            "message": error["message"],
            "severity": error["severity"],
        }
        for error in errors
    ]
    blocked = any(error["severity"] == "BLOCK" for error in errors)

    return {
        "type": _PROBLEM_TYPE,
        "title": _PROBLEM_TITLE,
        "status": 422 if blocked else 200,
        "blocked": blocked,
        "errors": migrated_errors,
    }
```
